title: VTT shared mechanics benefit payload v2
description: Shared payload: physical files are grouped per mechanical benefit type, NOT by class, species or item. Every entry has a source-qualified granted_by reference in catalog.schema.json.

id.description: Stable mechanics ID (not a translated display label).

name.description: Optional local display name, primarily for homebrew.

description.description: Optional local description, primarily for homebrew. Do not duplicate 5eTools prose.

activation.description: Action cost or triggering economy: action, bonus, reaction, free, contextual, etc.

trigger.description: When this benefit operates, such as on_hit, passive, long_rest, on_equip, activation.

operation.description: Mechanics engine operation; not the name of a specific feature.

mode.description: Mechanical mode such as toggle, context, advantage, or replacement.

formula.description: Engine expression, e.g. proficiency or cha_mod.

parameters.description: Explicit typed-mechanics payload for less common existing engines; schema validation does not imply runtime support.

note.description: Editorial explanation of nonautomated mechanics (not a replacement for 5eTools description).

action_id.description: Existing action identifier (e.g. dash/disengage) to which the feature grants access.

operation_id.description: Stable operation variant identifier (distinct from source feature name).

descriptive_only.description: Show source prose without an unusable action button.

passive.description: Automatically applies while source feature is owned and active.

time.description: Existing action timing used for roll bonuses, e.g. reaction or contextual.

roll_only.description: Offers a conditional roll modifier without a standalone action button.

required_optional_feature.description: A chosen optional feature required for application (source-qualified by optional_source).

optional_source.description: 5eTools source for the required optional feature.

kind.description: Kind of legacy activation; runtime uses the explicit action_id.

tracker_name.description: Reference to the exact tracker name.

ref.description: Canonical identity in 5eTools or a homebrew namespace.

source.description: Book/source code, e.g. PHB or XPHB

selector.description: Engine selector e.g. unarmed, melee, spell

condition_label.description: Optional explanatory UI text; avoid duplicated rules prose

proficiency_mode.description: How proficiency contributes, such as untrained_half, tool_expertise.

stack_group.description: Prevent stacking of mutually exclusive half-proficiency grants.

flat_bonus.description: Flat bonus applied to the selected rolls.

roll_mode.description: Alternative mode instead of numeric roll bonus.

attack_name.description: Restrict to a named attack already supplied by 5eTools.

requires_proficiency.description: The selected skill must be proficient.

type.description: walk, fly, swim, climb, burrow, jump, etc.

blocked_by_armor.description: Armor categories suppressing an existing movement mode; 5eTools retains the speed.

spellRuntime.description: Typed spell execution metadata currently stored in vtt/enrichment/spells.json; distinct from target/effect geometry.
